remarks:
Endless Possibilities & Investment Potential in Kendall!
Whether you're looking to expand your investment portfolio, searching for an owner-occupied property with income-producing potential, or looking for a property with room to grow, 16850 Roosevelt Highway in Kendall, NY, offers a unique opportunity to bring your vision to life!

Situated on nearly an acre of land, this property offers space, versatility, and exciting possibilities for homeowners, investors, and entrepreneurs alike. The expansive property provides room to enjoy the outdoors, explore future improvements, or make the most of the space available. Inside, bring your ideas and creativity to transform this property into something unique and truly special.

A standout feature is the huge garage, offering abundant space for vehicles, storage, equipment, hobbies, or workshop potential. Whether you're a car enthusiast, contractor, hobbyist, or simply in need of extra room, this impressive space adds another layer of versatility and appeal.

Outside, enjoy the beautiful yard complete with a full invisible pet fence, giving your four-legged family members room to roam and play. With nearly an acre to work with, there's plenty of space for outdoor entertaining, gardening, recreation, and more.

For investors, this property presents an opportunity to explore long-term investment, with possibilities for future improvements or income-producing use, subject to zoning, permits, and applicable regulations. Owner-occupants will also appreciate the opportunity to build equity while exploring ways to maximize the property's functionality and value over time.

Conveniently located along Roosevelt Highway in Kendall, this property offers space, flexibility, and potential that's worth exploring. Bring your vision, unlock the possibilities, and make this property your next great adventure!
